description: Search 2497 readings taken from 234 arXiv papers' LaTeX source: citation stances (adopts, extends, disputes, measures against) and stated assumptions. Matches on the quoted sentence, the cue phrase that decided it, and the work cited. Returns the sentence verbatim with a link to the exact line.

query.description: Text to look for, e.g. 'layer normalization'

stance.description: Optional filter. The first five are citation stances; bare/cited/shown are what an assumption's own sentence offers for it.

name: search_library
title: Search what Keystone read
